sql: SELECT * FROM benchmark.orders WHERE customer_id = 2 AND order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
SELECT * FROM benchmark.orders WHERE customer_id = 3 AND order_date >= DATE '2026-06-01'
SELECT * FROM benchmark.orders WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-06-08'
SELECT o.order_id, o.total_amount, c.region FROM benchmark.orders o JOIN benchmark.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_id BETWEEN 1 AND 100
SELECT * FROM benchmark.orders WHERE customer_id = 2 ORDER BY order_date DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(total_amount) AS total_sales FROM benchmark.orders GROUP BY status
